story_clusters.headline: Foreign Minister Braže emphasizes need for more agile NATO capabilities
story_clusters.summary: Foreign Minister Baiba Braže stressed that NATO must become more capable of action according to geopolitical reality. She also reported Latvia has contributed 17.2 million euros to NATO's PURL initiative for critical defense procurement from the US.

story_clusters.headline: Latvian Police assist in shutting down fraud network in Ukraine
story_clusters.summary: Latvia's State Police, cooperating with foreign law enforcement agencies, helped shut down an organized crime network operating fraudulent call centers in Ukraine. The operation resulted in arrests and investigation of investment fraud schemes.

story_clusters.headline: Suspended judge continues working as judicial assistant despite fraud conviction
story_clusters.summary: A judge who was convicted of fraud and suspended from office continues to work as a judicial assistant. The case involves allegations of fictitious employment of an archivist who received salaries, bonuses and awards for work not performed.
